descriptions.text: Seize the Day Toothpaste – Five Applications. You know that feeling you get when you walk out into the world with minty-fresh breath? It's like you can take on any challenge that is thrown your way. It gives you confidence. It boosts your self-esteem. It makes you feel like you're on top of the damn world. Well, this stuff does none of that. However, if you brush your teeth using this enchanted, cherry-flavored toothpaste, you are imbued with the following buffs for 30 hours: +Three Times Damage to all Boss Monsters. or +Four Times Damage to all Boss Monsters if the Boss is a Province, Country, or Floor Boss. This buff may only be applied in a safe room.

recap.text: Carl earns a Platinum Big Daddy Box by killing three bosses with one attack. Inside are a regular toothbrush and a tiny tube of toothpaste, red with a black skull and Carpe Diem in Comic Sans. Brushed in a safe room, each of its five applications gives thirty hours of triple damage to bosses, quadruple against a province, country or floor boss. Carl decides he must be stingy with it and adds it to his stash.

Inside the castle, Donut has to charm Ferdinand, a province boss, and her charisma must beat his constitution plus charisma by a hundred. Her base of 138 doubles to 276 for thirty hours under her benefactor-box tiara, which leaves her 101 points over before the safe room's buffs. With all her buffs and the Seize the Day Toothpaste bonus, her effective charm is well over three hundred. She insists it is not working, though they have already seen the effects.

beats.headline: Carpe Diem
beats.text: Killing three bosses with one attack earned Carl a Platinum Big Daddy Box, and it holds a regular, unenchanted toothbrush and a tiny, travel-sized tube of toothpaste: red, with a black skull, and Carpe Diem written on it in what appears to be Comic Sans. Five applications. Brushed in a safe room, it gives thirty hours of three times damage to all boss monsters, four times if the boss is a province, country or floor boss. A fantastic prize, Carl thinks, but only useful if he knows he is going to face a boss that day. He will need to be stingy. He adds it to his stash.
beats.gist: The Carpe Diem toothpaste triples boss damage for thirty hours, across five applications.

Her base is 138, and her new benefactor-box tiara doubles it to 276 for thirty hours, before the safe room's buffs: 101 points over. Her effective charm, with all her buffs plus the bonus from the Seize the Day Toothpaste, is well over three hundred. She insists it is not working, but they have already been seeing the effects.
beats.gist: Donut's tiara and toothpaste push her charm past three hundred against Ferdinand.
